projects.summary: TPAs have been drowning in paper for decades. Stax.ai wanted to replace all of it with one AI-powered system, and needed a brand that embodied that rather than decorated it. We built the system: animation that makes automation understandable, illustration and 3D for credibility.

projects.summary: TechSpeed had real talent behind a dated, cold identity — everything an all-women-led tech company shouldn't be. We started over: a new mark, a palette that reads capable and warm at once, custom animation, and a success-stories section that became their strongest conversion tool.

projects.summary: TinyFish had AI agents deployed inside major companies and no brand to match them. We built one from scratch: a visual system, a motion language, and a character — a thoughtful, methodical tiny fish that became the face of the technology, and "the shoal" behind it.

projects.title: Upshop
projects.summary: We built Upshop's first brand and have been their partners ever since. As they grew into Upshop 360, the original identity started feeling too small. We sharpened it: new strategy, reimagined typography, motion that carries the story, and a site that moves as fast as the business.
projects.quote: Through thick and thin, they are Upshop's go-to for brand + digital.

projects.title: In Revenue Capital
projects.summary: In Revenue Capital needed to look expert without being intimidating. We built the brand and the site on a less-is-more philosophy: flat but immersive, big imagery, generous white space, custom illustration, and an insights blog they still run today.

projects.title: Prosupps
projects.summary: ProSupps had bold branding and premium products, and a digital presence that didn't match the energy. We built an immersive, effects-driven store — 3D visuals, ambassador video, nutrition in searchable HTML — then restructured the sales flow around discovery.
projects.alt: Graphic highlighting ProSupps’ commitment to quality with “Substance Tested / Licensed Ingredients” text.

projects.title: New Engen
projects.summary: New Engen arrived with a fresh identity and a merger underway. We built the digital half: custom illustration, Rive animation, transitions engineered to feel like the genuine impact they promise, and one home for two companies. They took the toolkit and ran with it.
projects.quote: Engaged sessions are up 78% and Active users from organic sources are up 57%.

projects.title: Suzy Welch
projects.summary: Suzy Welch had a reputation and no brand to amplify it. We built the foundation, then an ecosystem of assessment platforms around it: Pi360, Compass Careers, Four Horsemen and the breakout Values Bridge. Not quizzes — real engines with intricate scoring and personal results.
projects.quote: We have had 65,000 users for the values bridge since 5 months of launch.

projects.title: Everest ERP
projects.summary: Everest built an ERP for the AI era, not a legacy system with a fresh coat of paint, and nothing about their presence said so. We built the identity to carry it: typography that is technical and readable, animation that makes automation tangible, interfaces that show the real thing.
projects.quote: Everest emerges from stealth mode with a landmark $140 million funding.

projects.summary: Elevate genuinely cares about their customers in an industry famous for fine print, and looked like everyone else in it. We warmed the whole thing up: approachable typography, custom illustration, an inviting palette, and a site built around the app they are proudest of.

projects.summary: Five Pathways wanted retirement planning to feel like anything but. A hot air balloon guiding clients through five routes became the north star: an editorial illustration system, a virtual office where you meet the team, an animated AI assistant, and a claw machine that gives clients real gifts.
projects.quote: The experience has been beyond wonderful, and I view them as a partner in our company's growth strategy.

projects.title: Hugo
projects.summary: Hugo blends people and AI to help businesses scale, and needed an identity that reads as a partner rather than an outsourcer. We built one around motion: a custom animated loader that shifts and changes colour as a living engine, and transitions that keep everything moving.
projects.quote: Since launching the new Hugo website, visitors are spending over two minutes on service pages, the bounce rate has dropped to 33%, and conversions are up to 6–7%.

projects.summary: Altgage helps people save up to $100,000 over a thirty-year mortgage and had no visual identity to say so. We built one around custom illustration and a fresh palette — friendly enough to demystify mortgages, credible enough for a financial product — with calculators built in.

projects.summary: Portal is building toward trust minimisation and peer-to-peer freedom, and their brand hadn't caught up. We reimagined it as an evolution: a waving flag as the motif — motion, freedom, the revolution they are pushing — with layered motion that turns complexity into discovery.

projects.title: Shardeum
projects.summary: Shardeum had the rarest thing in crypto — a genuinely massive, engaged community — and a site that couldn't keep up. We built the visual system out of the name itself, with shards of the logo running through the whole thing, and a blog robust enough for their volume.
projects.alt: Abstract 3D scene featuring the Shardeum logo surrounded by colorful geometric shapes, representing the brand’s modern digital identity and visual system.

projects.title: MindJoin
projects.summary: MindJoin needed a brand that could make a pretty technical idea feel approachable without watering it down. We handled the branding, website design, and development, building a bold visual system around expressive illustration, oversized typography, and a lot of personality. The result feels smart, distinctive, and easy to remember.
projects.alt: MindJoin

projects.title: Saffron Finance
projects.summary: Saffron needed to feel like serious DeFi, but we did not want the site to feel cold or overly technical. We used storytelling to help lead people through the product, then brought in these more organic marble forms to represent roots, growth, and the idea of something continuing to build over time.
projects.alt: Saffron Finance

projects.title: Ultra Red
projects.summary: ULTRA RED already had a bold personality. We weren’t interested in sanding that down just to make cybersecurity feel more “serious.” The pink, the color, the energy, all of it became something to push harder, not hide. We leaned all the way in and built a brand that feels confident, loud, and completely comfortable standing apart from the category.
projects.alt: Ultra Red

projects.title: Flatiron Sports
projects.summary: Flatiron Sports was built to capture the emotion of being at a live sporting event. The energy, anticipation, and sense of wow that comes with it. At the same time, the brand needed to feel bigger than any one sport, creating a flexible visual world that could move naturally across all kinds of athletes, teams, and experiences.
projects.alt: Flatiron Sports

projects.title: Fountain
projects.summary: Fountain needed to feel advanced without dressing the brand up in a bunch of unnecessary futurism. We wanted to pull more from the clinical, research-driven side of what they do and let that give the brand its confidence. The system is precise, technical, and highly considered, with just enough warmth to keep it human.
projects.alt: Fountain

projects.title: Geneva Med
projects.summary: GENEVA was built around the balance between beauty and science. We wanted the brand to carry the calm, elevated feeling of a spa while still showing the clinical thinking, precision, and expertise behind every treatment.
projects.alt: Geneva Med
